nom: cocokind Daily SPF 32 Mineral Facial Sunscreen

segments.oily: Oily and acne-prone reviewers are split: several say it does not add oiliness or trigger breakouts, but a few describe it looking greasy or leaving skin oily by the end of the day, especially in summer or heat.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally report hydration and a soothing feel, with several calling it moisturizing and non-drying.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as balanced, non-irritating, and not making their skin feel oily or dry.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with sensitive eyes, largely report good tolerance with no stinging, hives, or breakouts, though one notes lingering white cast and eye irritation when sweating.
segments.normal: A normal-skin reviewer reports no breakouts, dryness, or oiliness with regular use.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically identify mature skin.

concerns.aging: Not addressed directly by any reviewer; no comments on fine lines, firmness, or aging-specific results.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the formula as hydrating and glow-giving, with a few using it in place of a separate moisturizer; no reports of it causing dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with facial redness reports a more noticeable white cast; no other redness-specific complaints or improvements are mentioned.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin generally report no irritation or reaction, but a couple mention eye irritation or a suffocating, occlusive feel that made them stop using it.
concerns.spots: No reviewer discusses hyperpigmentation or dark spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some say it helps skin overall; a few report it makes skin feel oily or heavy without directly causing new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are mixed: many say it is lightweight and not oily, absorbing well or drying to a matte-ish finish, while several others describe a persistent oily, tacky, or greasy feel, particularly with sweat or in summer.

aspects.libelle: Thick texture requiring effort to blend
Feels tacky or occlusive over time

extraits.texte: Will be returing. Left a very noticeable white cast no matter how little of the product I used. It also felt extremely heavy, like my skin was suffocating, I tried to give it a chance for a few hours but had to wash it off. I went with this product for the clean ingredients and cocokind usually has good products that i gravitate to.
I have oily, acne prone skin and after wearing this sunscreen all day it made my skin look really oily. I recently purchased the Beauty of Josen Suncreen and its a lot better for oily skin.

Very good sunscreen, it works for my acne prone skin and is also very moisturizing. Especially if you have dry skin. This also gets a good rating on the Yuka app which lets me rest at peace. I also appreciate the sustainability features.

This facial sunscreen is the best, I have dry acne-prone skin and this doesnt break me out. It does leave a white cast on my medium skin tone, so becareful with the amount that you use. But its isnt as noticeable unless youre lathering on your face. A little goes a long way!

extraits.titre: All Mineral Sunscreens have a cast. This is THE best of them
extraits.texte: Alll mineral sunscreens will leave a cast on brown skin, but I still LOVE this sunscreen. I have super sensitive skin and have tried a dozen mineral sunscreens looking for something my skin will tolerate. This leaves the least amount of cast and doesn't send my skin into a tizzy. Please, please: change nothing. And for those who want a cast-free sunscreen, look into chemical or something with more emollients. Leave this one alone as one of the few I can tolerate. It goes on well, is a fab primer/ base for my mineral makeup and doesn't leave me with angry red bumps and an itchy face.

I started using this sunscreen a year ago and I have never looked back! I have very sensitive, combo skin and this spf does not irritate me at all! When it initially goes on, there is a slight white cast, but it quickly goes away if you continue to rub on the skin. Love this moisturizer/spf combo and could not recommend it more, will definitely continue to repurchase.
great for sensitive skin!!! i've never met a sunscreen before this one that doesn't break me out in hives, but i love this bottle :)
